1_baseline_lock.details: V3.3.2 remains frozen as V3.3.2_FINAL_RECONCILED. Zero hash drift across all 39 protected artifacts verified by test_v3_2_1_immutability.py.

2_model_h_formula_audit.details: Runtime implementation in run_exp_333_01.py deviated structurally from canonical Model H across distance, illumination, and pitch terms.

3_k_value_reconciliation.details: Report contradicted itself by presenting runtime range [2.70, 3.151] alongside theoretical far-field 3.35. Exact evaluated population: runtime k in [2.7000, 3.1513], canonical lower bound in [2.4000, 2.7713], canonical worst-case upper bound in [2.9800, 3.3513].

4_detection_count_reconciliation.details: Exact 251 detection instances reconciled: forklift=238, person=13. Near=43, mid=201, far=7. All quantities derived from observation ledger.

5_distance_stratum_reconciliation.details: Counts verified: 43+201+7=251 across all detections. Previous semantic ODD split rejected.

6_odd_classification_audit.details: Physical sensor data for camera height, pitch, and lux are missing. Overall ODD_STATUS = UNKNOWN.

7_terminology_governance.details: Removed VALIDATED_IN_ODD_OBSERVED. Replaced with OBSERVED_ZERO_ADAPTATION_BEHAVIOR and ODD_STATUS_UNKNOWN.

8_perception_claim_governance.details: Human ground truth unavailable. Statistical F1, precision, recall, and 85% gate marked NOT_ESTABLISHED.

9_person_detection_claim.details: Changed 'severe false-negatives' to LOW_OBSERVED_PERSON_DETECTION_RATE and VISUAL_DETECTION_MISS.

10_tracking_interpretation.details: Track sequence [1, 5, 9, 12] classified as TRACK_FRAGMENTATION of 1 physical forklift, not true physical identity switches.

11_safe_transit_claim.details: Reclassified minimum separation as ESTIMATED_MINIMUM_SEPARATION = 4.2m [MODEL_ESTIMATE], not surveyed clearance.

13_track_split_architecture.details: Both EXP_333_01A and EXP_333_01B assigned to EXTERNAL_ODD_STATUS_UNKNOWN due to absence of physical measurements.
